name: Triumph International Finance India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Triumph International Finance India Ltd is in the business of providing Financial Services[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:
a) Brokerage Services:[1]
The company is a full brokerage offering access to the equity market through NSE and BSE. However, their services are suspended
b) Research:[2]
The company prepares reports covering various aspects like macro economic analysis, Industry analysis, Sectoral studies, technical analysis of equities, and any other special assignment. However, these services are also suspended
c) Corporate Finance:[3]
Company was a Category I Merchant Banker and assisted clients in mobilising / deploying short term funds, bill discounting, intercorporate term financing, working capital

cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.76 Cr.
